title: RAG Corpus Export Schema
description: Formal schema for declarative repository-to-RAG corpus bundling for high-context models and Google NotebookLM.

title.description: Human-readable title of the repository or corpus

description.description: High-level description of what the repository contains

target_system.description: Target ingestion system and its constraints

max_words_per_volume.description: Maximum word count per volume (NotebookLM cap is 500k words)

max_chars_per_volume.description: Soft maximum character count per volume

max_volumes.description: Maximum number of volumes (NotebookLM cap is 50 sources per notebook)

global_exclusions.description: Glob patterns to ignore across all volumes

id.description: File prefix and identifier for the volume (e.g. 01_architecture)

description.description: Contextual prompt embedded at the head of the volume for the RAG model

include.description: Glob patterns or file paths to include in this volume

priority_files.description: Files that should appear at the top of the volume before other matched files

strip_html.description: Whether to convert HTML files in this volume into clean Markdown
